'''1999 Kashyyyk Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional on 12 September 1999. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d49">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-20-kashyyyk-regionals-9-12-99d49/ kashyyyk-regionals-9-12-99], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 20 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-20-kashyyyk-regionals-9-12-99d49/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 September 1999
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
